speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pediatric patient with a 3-week history of fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe leg pain. To begin my assessment, how old are you, and has anyone noticed any swelling in your joints or hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leukemia (likely Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia)

Given the age of the patient and the classic triad of fatigue, bruising, and severe bone pain waking her at night, I need to see the Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and a Peripheral Blood Smear immediately to confirm the presence of blasts.
